title: Transfer Miles Added Where a Car Rental Is Collected at an Airport Branch
content:
Collection at an airport branch adds a transfer allowance to the mileage granted on a rental of the Car Rental Rate Classes. Whether collection was at an airport branch is read from the airport surcharge line standing on the rental's ledger, and the allowance then turns on where the vehicle is returned.

**The transfer schedule.**

| What stands on the ledger, and where the vehicle is returned | Miles added |
|---|---|
| An airport surcharge line, the vehicle returned to a branch other than the one it was collected from | 90 |
| An airport surcharge line, the vehicle returned to the branch it was collected from | 140 |
| No airport surcharge line | Nothing on that account |

**Why the two differ.** The one-way figure of 90 miles covers the transfer in a single direction; the figure of 140 miles covers a return to the branch of collection. Where no airport surcharge line stands on the rental's ledger, nothing at all is added under this head, whichever branch the vehicle goes back to.

**Cases on hypothetical rentals.** A rental whose ledger carries an airport surcharge line, collected at one branch and returned to another, has 90 miles added. The same rental returned to the branch it was collected from has 140 miles added. A rental whose ledger carries no airport surcharge line has nothing added, even where the collection and return branches differ.
